text: {"precondition":"Customer Joe's Auto Repair is confirmed as account ID 1 with silver pricing; warehouse ID 1 is available. Look up all three SKUs to obtain their part IDs, categories, and list prices before creating lines.","decision_rule":"Create the order for the requested ship date, then call the pricing-rules tool for each part using account ID 1, its category and quantity, and the order date. Use each returned unit price, list price, and discount when adding its line; set backorder_status to \"allow\". Do not assume zero discounts or invent other pricing inputs.","expected_transition":"An open sales order for account 1 is created with the requested ship date and three lines for the specified quantities. Each line reflects the pricing-rule result, and backordering is allowed.","recovery_check":"After line creation, inspect the order's lines and confirm all three SKUs, quantities, prices, discounts, and backorder statuses. If anything is missing or inconsistent, use the available order and line lookup/update tools to check or correct it."}
